# Product Traction

## Overview
Product traction for [Aurora Labs](./aurora-labs.md) reflects the current deployment status, technical milestones, and operational hurdles faced by the company as of July 2026. Outlined in an internal investor update draft by CEO [Mira Chen](./aurora-nova-widget-v2.md), the metrics cover field deployments, [software releases](./software-releases.md), [hardware](./hardware.md) compromises, and the strategic financial needs of the company.

## Key Details
- **[Nova Widget](./nova-widget.md) Field Units:** There are currently 47 beta Nova Widget units active in the field.
- **[MeshSync](./meshsync.md) Software:** Version 0.3.8 of MeshSync has shipped, featuring a rejoin fix that successfully unblocks 8-node deployments.
- **Investor Demonstrations:** A [wiki compiler](./wiki-compiler.md) demo recently impressed a seed investor, drawing a mention of the "karpathy pattern."
- **Hardware & Tooling Adjustments:** The $8k IP65 tooling expenditure has been deferred. As a mitigation, Aurora Labs is shipping an IP54 beta variant accompanied by clear splash-resistance language.
- **Competitive Landscape:** The [SenseNode SN-400](./sensenode-sn-400.md) continues to win the outdoor waterproof narrative due to its IP67 rating.
- **Financing Ask:** Aurora Labs is seeking a $500k bridge financing round dedicated to funding injection molds and hiring 2 full-time equivalent (FTE) [firmware](./firmware.md) engineers.

## Related Entities
- **Aurora Labs:** The company developing the Nova Widget, MeshSync, and related hardware/software solutions.
- **Mira Chen:** CEO of Aurora Labs and author of the investor update draft.
- **Nova Widget:** The primary hardware product currently undergoing beta field testing (47 units deployed).
- **MeshSync:** Proprietary software (shipped at version 0.3.8) handling network coordination and multi-node deployments.
- **SenseNode SN-400:** A competing product featuring an IP67 waterproof rating that dominates the outdoor narrative.
- **Alex Kim:** Reached out regarding potential co-marketing at Maker Faire (currently deferred).
- **[TeaBuddy](./teabuddy.md):** A separate entity or project associated with Alex Kim, sharing a CR2032 supply chain connection.

## Related Concepts
- **IP54 vs. IP65 Tooling Mitigation:** The strategic decision to defer expensive IP65 injection molds in favor of shipping an IP54-rated beta unit with updated product [documentation](./documentation.md) regarding splash resistance.
- **Bridge Financing:** A $500k [fundraising](./fundraising.md) target aimed at securing immediate manufacturing molds and expanding the firmware engineering team.
- **Documentation Reconciliation:** Resolving internal discrepancies regarding [product specifications](./product-specifications.md), such as conflicting [battery life](./battery-life.md) claims.

## Contradictions
&gt; **Contradiction:** There is an internal documentation contradiction regarding battery lifespan claims for the product, which vary between 2 years and 18 months. Aurora Labs plans to resolve this by publishing a transparent [power budget](./power-budget.md) spreadsheet in Q3.
